closureGrammar.unitEncoding: 0x60 || component(0x61,unitId) || component(0x62,projectId) || component(0x64,requiredForCapability) || blob(0x68, concat(sorted object-ref items))
closureGrammar.sorting: object-ref item bytes sort unsigned ascending; unit record bytes form an EP4 set commitment and therefore deduplicate exact bytes then sort unsigned ascending
closureGrammar.duplicates: duplicate object refs, duplicate unitIds, duplicate unit bytes, duplicate owners, and duplicate proof refs are forbidden

unitIdContract.preimage: domainUtf8 || 0x00 || 0x60 || component(0x62,projectId) || component(0x64,requiredForCapability) || blob(0x68,concat(sorted object-ref items))

closureGrammar.availabilityBoundary: UnitAvailabilityRecordV1 and effectiveCapability are mutable/read-derived, may carry RunId, and remain outside semantic closure bytes and EvidenceDigest.

rules.resolveAndPin: atomically validate availability; require expectedPreviousFencingToken == durable lastIssuedFencingToken; allocate exactly last+1; persist one HELD lease with scoped pins
rules.purgeOrdering: HELD intersecting pins reject purge with LEDGER.BUSY_TIMEOUT
rules.release: matching owner/fence releases and atomically applies pending expiry
rules.crashReclaim: exact lease/owner/liveness/fence/ProjectId/scope plus dead owner and expired sequence atomically applies pending expiry, removes expired authority, then clears the lease
rules.expiryDuringUse: HELD live read continues; expiry becomes pending and applies at release
rules.idempotentRetry: same lease/owner/liveness/previous-fence/pins/expiry returns unchanged grant and never extends expiry
rules.fenceMonotonicity: durable lastIssuedFencingToken never decreases or resets; no later grant may reuse an issued fence
rules.composition: release or reclaim is reduced before any repin; expired objects remain ineligible while an available object receives only the next fence

invariants.assert: Pre-evaluation authority-seal identity, sealedCapability, and read-derived effectiveCapability are distinct; no terminal Run reference enters semantic closure.
Recorded is the safe floor and can never imply verifiability.
The orchestration host, not evidence producers, owns custody selection.
Durable authority requires an explicit project storage and retention policy.
The closed LeaseStateV2/EventV2 reducer owns atomic resolve, pin, purge, expiry, release, retry, identity-bound reclaim, durable monotonic fencing, and composition.
A live HELD lease blocks intersecting purge and defers intersecting expiry.
Crash reclaim requires exact lease, owner, liveness, fence, ProjectId and scope plus dead-owner/expiry evidence and atomically applies pending expiry before clearing.
Idempotent retry never changes pins or expiry; every new grant allocates durable lastIssuedFencingToken + 1 and no fence is reused.
Purge output is a complete derived partition, never a trusted label.
D9 rows carry every closed input axis and the complete derived termination payload plus exit code.

SemanticCapabilityClosureV2 gives every direct/transitive EP4 authority/proof reference, including all six historical roles, exactly one content-derived SemanticCustodyUnitV2 owner at its exact minimum.
UnitAvailabilityRecordV1 is Run-scoped mutable state outside EvidenceDigest; a partially unavailable unit confers none of that unit capability and effectiveCapability is read-derived only.
Semantic closure is ProjectId-scoped; downstream unit availability, lease, purge, and lineage records may add derived RunId only outside semantic bytes.
This candidate cannot accept product state, close dependencies, or apply integration state.
The v9 root, semantic closure, custody unit, availability record, grammar, and every retained subobject are recursively closed; unknown metadata or authority aliases reject.
